definitions.explanation: A list at the beginning of a book or document showing the chapters, sections, or topics and their page numbers.

examples.japanese: {目次|もくじ}を{見|み}て、{読|よ}みたい{章|しょう}を{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I looked at the table of contents and found the chapter I wanted to read.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}には{詳|くわ}しい{目次|もくじ}がついている。
examples.english: This book has a detailed table of contents.

examples.japanese: {目次|もくじ}は3ページにあります。
examples.english: The table of contents is on page 3.

notes:
{目次|もくじ} lists the contents and organization of a book, document, or publication.

Related terms:
- {索引|さくいん} (index - alphabetical list at the end)
- {章|しょう} (chapter)
- {節|せつ} (section)

Usage:
- {目次|もくじ}を{見|み}る (to look at the table of contents)
- {目次|もくじ}から{選|えら}ぶ (to choose from the table of contents)

Digital context:
In digital documents and websites, {目次|もくじ} may be interactive, with clickable links to each section.
